scope: Replace the imported flag decoder, character conditions and compound-pattern tokenizer with dependency-free JoyWord dictionary syntax. Raw and WCAFF2 readers/writers share the parser. The compact bytes and archive data remain interchangeable.
method: Both text readers, both compact writers and each writer with both compact readers. Hunspell read the published pair directly except where it explicitly rejected header counts: only its private reference copy had its four counts corrected in es-uy, hy and ta. Both product builds always used original archive bytes. A 65535 flag in the desktop probe exercises retained file compatibility.
timingMethod: Same optimized builds, 7 alternating pairs after warming, 2 compilations of already-decoded UTF-8 sources per observation. Time includes rule and dictionary indexing, excludes I/O and decoding. UOS pinned to one allowed core. Synthetic dictionary has 12000 rules and 9000 stems.
rollback: Restore the old syntax adapter and source ledger from 24c70ff9. Native save/open was replayed with both binaries, and all 99 compact outputs were byte-identical across writers. No installed dictionary conversion is required.
